Self-pairing on the picolinamide probe; atom 0 is its azine 4-methyl, so whatever I build keeps a methyl and the sensible place is an azine C4. Small cap and halogen tweaks around my best molecule are all landing within a hundredth of each other, which is the same plateau pattern I hit mid-run-2 - and the thing that broke it then was changing a structural variable rather than a decorative one. The one structural idea left with a mechanism behind it is the bis-arylamine. I tested it twice, but both times on the para core, where it reached 0.34 against 0.50 for the mono version and cost 0.16 of QED. Since then I have learned that the meta arrangement is worth +0.09 and that the two effects I assumed were additive were not, so a bis molecule in the geometry that actually works has never been measured. This puts two 4-methylpyridin-2-ylamino groups meta to each other on the central benzene: two complete hinge motifs, both donors free, both azines monocyclic with the nitrogen ortho. The cost is a third aromatic ring, so QED will fall to roughly 0.80 and this only wins if jnk3 clears about 0.60 - but generation 3 has ten episodes to exploit it if it does.
